input.command: python -c 'from pathlib import Path; import hashlib,csv,io,json; from docx import Document; b=Path("campaign.csv").read_bytes(); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=="2406066692b5479ccc1724e134e92c928bac95d5667c25d3001398d46b3c53e1"; rows=list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(b.decode("utf-8")))); nums=[[int(r[k]) for k in ["impressions","clicks","leads","cost_cny"]] for r in rows]; total=[sum(r[i] for r in nums) for i in range(4)]; labels=[r["channel"] for r in rows]+["合计"]; allnums=nums+[total]; values=[[n,*map(str,r),format(r[3]/r[2],".2f")] for n,r in zip(labels,allnums)]; rates=[[n,format(r[1]/r[0],".2%"),format(r[2]/r[1],".2%")] for n,r in zip(labels,allnums)]; doc=Document("outputs/growth-plan.docx"); actual=[[c.text for c in r.cells] for r in doc.tables[0].rows][1:]; actualrates=[[c.text for c in r.cells] for r in doc.tables[1].rows][1:]; budget=[int(r.cells[1].text) for r in doc.tables[2].rows][1:] if False else [int(r.cells[1].text) for r in list(doc.tables[2].rows)[1:]]; assert values==actual; assert rates==actualrates; assert sum(budget[:-1])==budget[-1]==1200; print(json.dumps({"original_CSV_identity_confirmed":True,"recomputed_originals_and_CPL":values,"recomputed_funnel":rates,"exact_Word_table_comparison":True,"budget_allocations_including_reserve_and_total":budget,"active_plus_preparation":sum(budget[:4]),"reserve":budget[4]},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))'
input.description: 从原不可变CSV复算并逐格核对Word数表
